game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about energy to power up the fire warden and open the ember furnace.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
